risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful operating metrics and quantified geographic concentration, billings, losses, investments, and SPAC commitments, but relies heavily on forward-looking expectations and broad risk disclaimers. Significant risks include substantial operating losses, dependence on California and low-wage high-turnover markets, execution risk around SPACs and technology investments, and uncertain future revenue realization.
